title: Stripe Live restricted key: one-property twin (public-prefix)
summary: 1 input is identical to a positive input except for one change: the prefix is that of a public sibling identifier rather than the secret. Legacy mutation notes: public-prefix: rk_live_ becomes pk_live_, the publishable namespace the provider documents as safe to expose (basis: provider). Twin of "Stripe Live restricted key, Stripe Live secret key and 1 more: must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of stripe-token-compose-restricted: public-prefix: rk_live_ becomes pk_live_, the publishable namespace the provider documents as safe to expose (basis: provider). The provider documents this namespace as public, so silence is provider-evidenced.
